entries.title: WKU receives $2 million to build a resilient microgrid for the DSOC
entries.desc: Kentucky's Office of Energy Policy, with funding from the U.S. Department of Energy's State Energy Program, awarded WKU $2 million under Kentucky's Resilient Microgrid Program. The microgrid on the WKU Innovation Campus will combine solar power, battery storage, existing backup generators and advanced controls to keep the Disaster Science Operations Center running through outages. Dr. Manmeet Singh is principal investigator. AIR Lab will build data and AI tools that link weather, energy use and emergency operations.

entries.title: Robert Lesoski, Andrew Byne and Antonio Nunes join AIR Lab
entries.desc: Three student researchers joined the lab. Robert Lesoski, a meteorology freshman, works on 3D severe weather modeling and high-performance computing. From the Gatton Academy, Andrew Byne explores AI with commercial satellite products, and Antonio Nunes works with satellite data and Earth2Studio for disaster prediction.

entries.title: Two papers accepted to the AI-Native Academia workshop at NeurIPS 2026
entries.desc: “ReviewShield: Defending LLM Reviewers Against In-Paper Prompt Injection under Instruction-Content Entanglement” (Somnath Luitel, Prabhjot Singh, Suraj Thapa, Manmeet Singh, Josh Durkee) was accepted as an oral, and “Talking a Rejection Into an Accept? Confidence Framing and the Model-Specific Style Sensitivity of LLM Reviewers” (Prabhjot Singh, Somnath Luitel, Manmeet Singh) as a poster.

entries.title: Dr. Manmeet Singh named among the world's top 5% of scientists
entries.desc: A global bibliometric ranking of more than 10 million researchers placed Dr. Singh in the top 5%, reflecting his work in AI, atmospheric, climate and disaster science.

entries.title: Prabhjot Singh joins AIR Lab as an external collaborator
entries.desc: Prabhjot Singh, an AI research scientist and MS student in AI at UT Austin, is collaborating with the lab on AI for disaster science and trustworthy AI.

entries.title: AirCast-SR presented at NSF EPSCoR SuperCollider 2026
entries.desc: Graduate researcher Somnath Luitel presented “AirCast-SR: A Foundation Model for Kilometer-Scale Atmospheric Super-Resolution via Conditional Diffusion” at the Kentucky NSF EPSCoR SuperCollider 2026 all-hands meeting in Lexington.

entries.title: MSc poster award at Environmental Intelligence 2026
entries.desc: Somnath Luitel received an MSc Poster Presentation Award at Environmental Intelligence 2026, hosted by the University of Exeter, UK.
